blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill$^{\infty}$, which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill$^{\infty}$ reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.
blocks.zh: 递归自修(RSI),其中一个系统也改善了改进方式,是通往AGI道路上的长期愿望. 语文人员越来越多地将程序知识储存在可重复使用的技能中。 优化技能提供了实现RSI的直接途径,因为优化程序本身可以被编码为技能. 然而,现有的技能优化者遵循手工设计的程序。 即使是演化出元技能的方法,也将它限制在固定的管道上,并为每一项任务重新学习. 我们介绍Skill$^{\infty}$,它使技能优化递归自我提升:元代理遵循元技能优化任务技能,并使用同一种程序优化元技能本身. 优化由代理主导. 元代理诊断出行刑痕迹,提出候选人,请求独立审查,并分配搜索预算. 元技能定义了这些步骤,允许自修来重写. 这种元技能也与任务技能脱钩,精炼出多种技能优化任务,再被再用来优化不同领域的任务技能. 与部署一样,两级技能都是通过本土技能发现加载的标准包. 在83项技能奔驰任务中,技能基金(Skill$^{\infty}$)的通过率为60.7%,而人造技能的通过率为56.4%,技能股的通过率为54.5%。

blocks.en:
Recursive self-improvement (RSI) refers to a system that improves not only its performance on tasks but also the procedure that produces these improvements ( Yudkowsky, 2007 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Because each gain can then accelerate the next, RSI has figured prominently in visions of artificial general intelligence (AGI), from the intelligence explosion envisioned by Good (1966) to Gödel machines ( Schmidhuber, 2003 ) .
More recently, skills have emerged as a common format for capturing the reusable procedural knowledge of language agents ( Anthropic, 2025b ) .
This format can also encode the procedure that optimizes skills.
Skills can thus encode both the target of improvement and the procedure that improves it, making skill optimization a direct and interpretable way to achieve RSI.
Skills also serve as a harness-agnostic medium for RSI, since Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025a ) , Codex ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , and OpenCode ( Anomaly, 2025 ) all load them through the same open specification ( Agent Skills, 2025 ) .
To realize this potential, skill optimization must improve not only skills but also the procedure that optimizes them.
blocks.zh:
递归自我改进(RSI)是指一种不仅在任务上表现更好,而且能产生这些改进的程序的系统(Yudkowsky,2007;Chen等人,2026).
因为每次增益都能够加速下一个增益, RSI在人工一般智能(AGI)的视觉中占据显著地位,从古德(1966年)设想的情报爆炸到哥德尔机器(Schmidhuber,2003年).
最近,技能已成为获取语言代理人可重复使用的程序知识的共同格式(Anthropic,2025b)。
这种格式还可以编码优化技能的程序.
因此,技能既可以编码改进的目标,也可以编码改进的程序,使技能优化成为实现RSI的直接和可解释的方式.
技能也作为RSI的牵引-不可知介质,因为Claude Code(Anthropic, 2025a), Codex(OpenAI, 2025),以及OpenCode(Anomaly, 2025)都通过相同的开放规格(Agent Swills, 2025)加载.
为了实现这一潜力,技能优化不仅必须改进技能,而且必须改进优化技能的程序。

blocks.en:
Recent approaches such as SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , CoEvoSkills ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and SkillEvolver ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) already optimize skills from execution feedback.
Despite differences in what they edit and how they verify candidates, these methods share one design choice.
The optimizer follows a hand-designed procedure, and what it learns while optimizing one skill does not transfer to the next.
MetaSkill-Evolve ( Wang et al., 2026b ) goes a step further: each search branch carries a meta-skill that configures the five agents of its pipeline, and the same pipeline refines this meta-skill.
However, the pipeline’s roles and wiring remain fixed, and each meta-skill is bound to the task skill it evolves with.
Some methods also optimize skills in a setting that differs from deployment ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
They inject the skill or prompt the agent to load it, so optimization never tests whether the agent would load the skill on its own.

诸如SkillOpt(Yang等人,2026年),CEVOSkills(Zhang等人,2026年b),SkillEvolver(Zhang等人,2026年a)等近期方法已经从执行反馈中优化了技能。
尽管在编辑内容以及如何核实候选人方面存在差异,但这些方法都有一个设计选择。
优化者遵循手工设计的程序,在优化一个技能的同时所学的东西不会转移到下一个技能.
MetaSkill-Evolve(Wang et al., 2026b)更进一步:每个搜索分支都携带一个元技能,配置其管道的五个代理,同一管道精炼这种元技能.
然而,管道的作用和线路仍然固定,每种元技能都与它所发展的任务技能相联。
一些方法在与部署不同的环境下也优化了技能(杨等人,2026年;张等人,2026年b).
它们注入技能或促使代理加载,因此优化从不测试代理是否自己加载技能.

blocks.en:
We believe that an optimizer that improves skills but not its own procedure will eventually stagnate.
RSI targets exactly this limitation.
In this work, we propose Skill ∞ \infty , a framework for recursively self-improving skill optimization.
A meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and applies the same procedure to the meta-skill itself .
The “ ∞ \infty ” in Skill ∞ \infty stands for two loops that meet at the meta-skill and feed into each other, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
Optimization in Skill ∞ \infty is agent-led : in each iteration, the meta agent diagnoses the parent skill from execution traces, proposes and evaluates candidates within the search budget, submits each candidate to an independent reviewer, and selects the next parent.
Self-improvement of the meta-skill refines this procedure, which in turn optimizes task skills more effectively.
We further decouple the meta-skill from task skills.
The meta-skill is refined on a set of skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize diverse task skills.
This decoupling amortizes the cost of self-improvement over task skill optimization.
Skills at both levels are also provided to agents through native skill discovery , as in deployment.
We neither inject a skill nor prompt an agent to load one.
Agents see only a skill’s name and description and decide whether to load it.
The description is therefore also included in the scope of optimization.

blocks.en:
We evaluate Skill ∞ \infty on 83 agentic tasks from SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026a ) , spanning eight domains, and on GPU kernel optimization from KernelBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) .
In the main comparison, all methods share the Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2025 ) as the harness and GPT-6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026b ) as the backbone model.
On SkillsBench, Skill ∞ \infty reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver, and on KernelBench it reaches a mean speedup of 1.62.
Without the self-improvement of the meta-skill, the pass rate falls to 55.9%.
Skill ∞ \infty still outperforms human-curated skills when the backbone model or the harness is replaced.
Case studies in Appendix C show that self-improvement changes how the meta agent acts, not only the wording of its instructions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The idea of RSI dates back to the argument for an intelligence explosion ( Good, 1966 ) .
Gödel machines ( Schmidhuber, 2003 ) later formalized it as a program that rewrites its own code once a rewrite is proven useful.
Long a vision of AGI, RSI has since been partly realized in agents built on language models.
STOP ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) runs a code-improving scaffold on its own code but notes that this is not full RSI, because the language model itself is not altered.
Research on self-evolving agents ( Gao et al., 2026 ) has introduced systems that rewrite their own logic or code ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026a ) or search over agent designs ( Hu et al., 2025 ) .
More recent systems make the meta-level modification procedure itself editable ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) or compose data, harness, and model updates ( Tan et al., 2026 ) .
R 2 Flow ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) trains a policy that orchestrates a skill library and commits verified edits to it.
These systems implement the optimizer as a program or a trained policy.
Skill ∞ \infty , however, encodes the optimizer’s procedure as a skill, which makes its recursive self-improvement direct, interpretable, and harness-agnostic.

blocks.en:
Agent skills package reusable procedures as portable directories that agents load on demand ( Anthropic, 2025b ; Agent Skills, 2025 ; Xu and Yan, 2026 ) .
This format has precedents in skill libraries, induced workflows, and programmatic web skills ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
A growing line of work learns skills from experience ( Ni et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) or optimizes them from execution feedback ( Alzubi et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Feng et al., 2026 ) .
SkillEvolver ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) writes its optimization procedure as a fixed meta-skill that audits candidate skills in separate agents.
Some methods go further and operate at the meta level, evolving meta-skills that guide skill optimization ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) , multi-agent system design ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , or context engineering ( Ye et al., 2026 ) .
These methods still evolve the meta-skill with a hand-designed procedure.
MetaSkill-Evolve ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , for instance, fixes the roles and wiring of its five-agent pipeline and binds each meta-skill to the task skill it evolves with.
Skill ∞ \infty instead writes an agent-led optimization procedure into the meta-skill and refines it through self-improvement on several skill optimization tasks.
Decoupled from task skills, the same meta-skill then optimizes diverse task skills.

blocks.en:
Skill optimization builds on prompt optimization.
Early methods select instructions that a language model proposes ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) or evolve populations of prompts ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Fernando et al., 2024 ) .
Subsequent methods optimize compound systems of model calls ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2025 ; Khattab et al., 2024 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , accumulate strategies in evolving contexts ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026f ) , or meta-learn system prompts that transfer across tasks ( Choi et al., 2025 ; Tao et al., 2026 ) .
These methods optimize text that the surrounding system inserts into the model’s context.
By contrast, Skill ∞ \infty optimizes skills, which bundle executable scripts and reference files, are loaded only when the agent judges them useful, and can even package the procedure that optimizes them.

随后的方法优化了模型调用的复合系统(Yukekgonul等人,2025年;Khattab等人,2024年;Agrawal等人,2026年),在不断变化的背景下积累战略。 (Suzgun等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年f月),或元教育系统促使跨任务转移(Choi等人,2025年;Tao等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We first formalize skills, native skill discovery, and task skill optimization by a meta-skill.
We then make the meta-skill an optimization target in its own right, so that a single agent-led procedure optimizes task skills and the meta-skill alike.
Finally, we decouple the meta-skill from task skills and extend native skill discovery to both levels.
blocks.zh:
我们首先将技能正规化,本土技能发现, 和任务技能优化 通过元技能。
然后我们让元技能本身成为一个优化目标,这样单一的代理引导程序就能优化任务技能和元技能.
最后,我们将元技能与任务技能脱钩,并将本地技能的发现扩展到两个层次。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en:
We adopt the Agent Skills specification ( Agent Skills, 2025 ) , an open format through which agents across harnesses share reusable procedural knowledge.
A skill package is a directory built around the SKILL.md file.
The front matter of SKILL.md declares the skill’s name and description, while the body holds the instructions.
The package may also bundle scripts, reference files, and other resources that the instructions invoke or cite.
With these resources, a skill can provide executable procedures and detailed conventions in addition to textual guidance.
An agent loads skills in stages, following a design principle known as progressive disclosure ( Anthropic, 2025b ) .
Initially, it sees only the name and description of each installed skill.
For a skill it judges useful for the current task, it then loads the full instructions and opens the bundled resources as needed.
A skill thus takes effect only when the agent activates it by loading its instructions.
We term this mechanism native skill discovery because it is built into agent harnesses and underlies skill use during deployment.
blocks.zh:
我们采用代理技能规范(代理技能,2025年),这是一种开放格式,通过该格式,跨行业的代理共享可重复使用的程序知识。
一个技能包是一个围绕SKILL.md文件构建的目录.
SKILL.md的前身是宣布技能的名称和描述,而身体则持有指示。
软件包还可以捆绑指令引用或引用的脚本,参考文件和其他资源.
有了这些资源,除了文字指导外,技能还可以提供可执行的程序和详细的公约。
代理人分阶段加载技能,遵循称为渐进披露的设计原则(Anthropic, 2025b)。
最初,它只看到每个安装技能的名称和描述.
对于它判断对当前任务有用的技能来说,它随即加载全部指令,并按需要打开捆绑的资源.
因此,一种技能只有在代理人通过加载其指示而激活时才生效。
我们称这一机制为本土技能发现,因为它被植入在部署期间使用技术的媒介和基础。

When the meta-skill improves itself, it is both the procedure that the meta agent follows and the target that this procedure optimizes.

blocks.en: 3.3 Agent-Led Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.3 代理人引导优化

blocks.en:
We place the meta agent at the helm of skill optimization, following a meta-skill that is editable by self-improvement. Algorithm 1 outlines the procedure, and Figure 2 depicts one of its iterations.
The meta agent first inspects the optimization history recorded in the archive.
It then diagnoses the parent skill from the execution traces of its rollouts.
Informed by this diagnosis, it creates one or two candidates from the parent, each justified by a proposal.
The meta agent evaluates the candidates and submits each to an independent reviewer.
Finally, it decides whether to continue and selects either the next parent or the optimized skill.
blocks.zh:
我们把元代理放在技能优化的主导位置,遵循一种可以通过自我改进来编辑的元技能. 算法1概述了这个程序,图2描绘了它的一个迭代.
元代理首先检查存档中记录的优化历史.
然后从推出的行刑痕迹中诊断出父母的技能。
根据这种诊断,它从父母中产生一两个候选人,每个候选人都有建议的理由。
元代理评审候选人,并分别提交独立评审.
最后,它决定是否继续并选择下一位家长或优化的技能.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Agent-led optimization in Skill ∞ \infty
blocks.zh: 算法 1 在 Skill 中由代理引导优化

blocks.en:
Agent-led optimization entrusts the search to the meta agent’s reasoning rather than to a hand-designed heuristic driven by scores.
A score reveals whether a candidate improved but not why, so the meta agent interprets it in light of the diagnoses and reviews recorded in the archive.
The diagnoses can uncover a promising change that the score has yet to reflect, such as a tied candidate that makes progress on the failure it targets.
Much as evolutionary search retains less fit candidates to escape local optima, the meta agent can build on such candidates instead of discarding them.
It may likewise keep the parent when a candidate’s gain cannot be attributed to its change, or backtrack to an earlier skill when a line of revisions stalls.
Beyond choosing parents, the meta agent decides which failures to address next, redirecting the search as new evidence emerges.
In sum, search becomes reasoning about the failure modes of each target skill rather than a heuristic applied to all.
blocks.zh:
代理主导的优化将搜索委托给元代理的推理,而不是由分数驱动的手工设计的heuristic.
得分显示一名候选人是否有所改进,
诊断可以发现一个有希望的变化,而得分还没有反映出来,例如,一个附带条件的候选者在所要达到的失败方面取得进展。
由于进化搜索保留了不太适合逃避本地Otitima的候选人,元代理可以依靠这些候选人而不是抛弃他们.
如果候选人的收益不能归结于其变化,它也可以保留其父母,或者在一线修改停滞时,回溯到较早的技能。
除了选择父母外,元代理决定哪些失败解决下一步,随着新证据的出现重新定位搜索.
总之,搜索成为每个目标技能的失败模式的推理,而不是适用于所有人的热情。

blocks.en:
Only candidates that pass an independent review are eligible for selection.
The reviewer operates in an isolated context, shielded from both the meta agent’s deliberation and its partiality toward its own changes.
The verdict rests solely on the parent and candidate packages, the proposal, and the supporting evidence.
The reviewer rejects candidates that make no substantive change, that are never activated, or that are unusable as written.
Any gain from such candidates can arise only by chance, and rejecting them prevents selection from mistaking noise for progress.
For a meta-skill candidate, the reviewer further verifies that the core responsibilities of a meta-skill, including the review itself, remain intact.
blocks.zh:
只有通过独立审查的候选人才有资格获选。
评论员在孤立的环境下运作,既不受元代理人的审议,也不受其对自身变化的偏袒。
判决完全取决于父母和候选人的一揽子计划、提案和佐证。
审查者拒绝不作实质性改变、从未启用或无法使用的书面候选人。
从这些候选人那里获得的任何好处只能是偶然的,拒绝他们可以防止选择错误地把噪音当作进步。
对于元技能候选人,审查者进一步核实元技能的核心责任,包括审查本身,保持不变。

blocks.en:
The meta agent allocates the search budget itself, deciding how many candidates to create in each iteration and when to stop.
The number of candidates per iteration sets the balance between exploration and exploitation.
Several candidates probe alternative revisions side by side, whereas a single candidate pursues one line of revisions in depth.
Across target skills, a fixed schedule would allocate the same budget regardless of how much headroom remains.
The meta agent instead adapts its spending to each target skill, continuing while failures persist and stopping once the diagnosis finds little left to improve.
blocks.zh:
元代理自行分配搜索预算,决定每个迭代中要创建多少候选人以及何时停止.
每期候选人人数为勘探和开发提供了平衡。
若干候选人并肩调查备选修订案,而一个候选人则深入探讨一行修订案。
不论有多少头室,固定的时间表将分配同样的预算。
相反,元剂使支出适应于每种目标技能,而失败则持续存在,一旦诊断发现几乎没有改进余地,就停止。

blocks.en:
The steps of Algorithm 1 are encoded in the meta-skill rather than hard-coded, so the recursive loop of Section 3.2 can rewrite the procedure itself.
Any part of the package, from the instructions to the bundled scripts, is open to revision.
Freed from any predefined design space, the procedure can evolve beyond the foresight of human designers and realize its full potential.
Self-improvement can remedy a weak step wherever it lies, even in the review and selection of candidates, which a fixed pipeline would leave untouched.
Optimizing task skills reveals the shortcomings of the procedure, and each refinement in turn yields better task skills, rendering the two levels mutually reinforcing.
To keep the mutual reinforcement genuine, scoring lies beyond the reach of self-improvement, so gains can arise only from better optimization, never from reward tampering.
blocks.zh:
算法1的步法在元技能中编码而不是硬编码,因此第3.2节的递归循环可以重写程序本身.
包中的任何部分,从指令到捆绑的脚本,都可以进行修改.
从任何预设的设计空间中解放出来,该程序可以超越人类设计者的预见,实现它的全部潜力.
自我改进可以弥补任何薄弱的一步,即使在审查和挑选候选人方面也是如此,因为固定的管道不会受到影响。
优化任务技能揭示了程序上的缺陷,而每次改进反过来又产生更好的任务技能,使两级相辅相成。
要使相互加强是真实的,得分的谎言超出自我改善的范畴,所以收益只能来自更好的优化,永远不能来自奖励篡改.

blocks.en: 3.4 Decoupling Meta-Skill from Task Skills
blocks.zh: 3.4 将元技能与任务技能脱钩

blocks.en:
Skill ∞ \infty decouples the meta-skill from the task skills it optimizes.
The meta agent first refines a seed meta-skill m 0 m_{0} into m ⋆ m^{\star} on a set of skill optimization tasks Q Q drawn from different domains.
Each candidate meta-skill is scored by Equation 3 on the inner optimizations it guides, one for each q ∈ Q q\in Q within the inner budget B q B_{q} .
The refined meta-skill m ⋆ m^{\star} then guides the optimization of each target task skill from its seed.

This decoupling separates concerns: the meta-skill captures how to optimize skills, and each task skill how to solve its tasks.
Averaging gains over Q Q , the meta score favors revisions that help across domains over those tailored to one.
As a standard skill package, the refined meta-skill serves all task skills optimized afterwards, amortizing the cost of self-improvement across them.
blocks.zh:
这种脱钩将关注分开:元技能捕捉到如何优化技能,每个任务技能如何解决任务.
与Q相比,元评分有利于修改,
作为一套标准技能,经过改进的元技能服务于后来最优化的所有任务技能,分期摊还自修费用。

blocks.en: 3.5 Native Skill Discovery at Both Levels
blocks.zh: 3.5 两个层次的土著技能发现

blocks.en:
Skills at both levels are installed in the harness’s standard skill location and loaded through native skill discovery, as in deployment.
No skill is injected into a prompt, nor is any agent instructed to load one.
Gains measured under these conditions need no injection to materialize in deployment.
For task skills and the meta-skill alike, activation thus hinges on the description, which joins the instructions within the scope of optimization.
Like any skill, the meta-skill is portable across harnesses that support native skill discovery.

这两个级别的技能都安装在吊带的标准技能位置上,并通过本地技能的发现(如部署)加载。
没有将技能注入一个提示,也没有指示任何代理人加载一个提示.
在这些条件下衡量的收益在部署时不需要注入。
对于任务技巧和元技能都一样,激活因此取决于描述,它结合优化范围内的指令.
与任何技能一样,元技能是可移植的,跨越支持本土技能发现的绳索.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate Skill ∞ \infty on SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026a ) and KernelBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) against baselines with and without skills.
Beyond the main results, we ablate self-improvement and test generality across harnesses and models. We further locate where Skill ∞ \infty helps and measure how performance scales with the search budget and what optimization costs.

We optimize task skills on the dataset released with SkillEvolver ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) and test them on its 83 SkillsBench tasks from eight domains.
KernelBench challenges an agent to replace a PyTorch reference model with a faster implementation that computes the same outputs.
Following SkillEvolver, we optimize one task skill shared across three level-3 problems whose reference models are a deep narrow MLP, ShuffleNet, and a GRU.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Our main comparison asks whether automatically optimized skills can rival those curated by humans. Table 1 reports pass rates on SkillsBench, overall and per domain.
Skill ∞ \infty attains the highest overall pass rate, 60.7%, surpassing both human-curated skills (56.4%) and SkillEvolver (54.5%).
By contrast, SkillCreator (48.0%) and self-generated skills (42.9%) remain close to the agent without a skill (45.5%).
Across domains, Skill ∞ \infty leads in software engineering, media, and mathematics.
From a generic seed, Skill ∞ \infty alone among automatic methods builds task-specific procedural knowledge that serves the agent better than human-curated skills.

技能的通过率最高,为60.7%,超过了人造技能(56.4%)和技能高手(54.5%)。

在最狭窄的MLP和ShuffleNet上,Skill \\fty分别获得1.87和1.97,而SkillEvolver则分别获得1.12和1.39.
除了代理成功与否 Skill Q&infty 也提高了它的性能,几乎将SkillEvolver的增益四倍于没有技能的代理.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation of Self-Improvement
blocks.zh: 4.3 自我改善

blocks.en:
Self-improvement refines the procedure that subsequently optimizes task skills.
To quantify its contribution, we replace the refined meta-skill with its seed and report the result as Skill ∞ \infty w/o self-improvement in Table 1 .
Even with the seed meta-skill, Skill ∞ \infty reaches an overall pass rate of 55.9%, which is higher than those of SkillEvolver and the other automatic baselines.
The refined meta-skill improves the pass rate further to 60.7%.
Self-improvement helps most in mathematics, media, and software engineering, by 24.0, 22.2, and 11.4 points, respectively.
We attribute these gains to a stricter standard of evidence that self-improvement wrote into the meta-skill.
The refined meta-skill confirms a fix only when the candidate’s rollout shows progress on the targeted failure, not when the revised skill merely mentions it.
The agent-led procedure alone surpasses the automatic baselines, and by refining it, self-improvement places Skill ∞ \infty above human-curated skills.
blocks.zh:
自修完善了随后优化任务技能的程序.
为了量化其贡献,我们用种子取代精细的元技能,并在表1中报告结果为Skill \\ fty w/o自我改进。
即使有了种子元技能,Skill \\fty总的通过率也达到了55.9%,高于SkillEvolver和其他自动基线.
精细的元技能将通过率提高到60.7%。
自我改进对数学,媒体,软件工程帮助最大,分别达到24.0分,22.2分和11.4分.
我们把这些收益归结为更严格的证据标准,即自我改进写入元技能中.
精细的元技能证明,只有在候选人的推出表明目标失败方面有所进展时,而不是在经过精练的技能仅仅提到这一点时,才能找到解决办法。
仅由代理人主导的程序就超过了自动基线,通过精炼,自我改进使Skill QQ\\ft 凌驾于人类精密技能之上.

blocks.en: 4.4 Generality across Harnesses and Models
blocks.zh: 4.4 跨哈内斯和模型的通用性

blocks.en: Figure 4: Results with another backbone model or harness. Test pass rate (avg@5, %) on SkillsBench. Appendix D gives the per-domain results.

blocks.en:
The meta-skill is agnostic to the harness and the backbone model, so Skill ∞ \infty extends to other settings.
We evaluate it in two further settings that replace either the backbone model with GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026a ) or the harness with OpenCode ( Anomaly, 2025 ) . Figure 4 compares Skill ∞ \infty with human-curated skills under the same harness and model.
Skill ∞ \infty reaches 66.5% with GPT-5.6 Luna and 56.9% with OpenCode, against 61.2% and 53.3% for human-curated skills, respectively.
Built on standard skill packages, Skill ∞ \infty keeps its advantage over human-curated skills across harnesses and backbone models.

元技能对吊带和骨干模型是不可知的,因此Skill QQ\fty延伸到其他设置.
我们用另外两个环境来评价它,或者用GPT-5.6 Luna(OpenAI, 2026a)来取代主干模型,或者用OpenCode(Anomaly, 2025)来取代牵引装置。 图4 将Skill QQ\fty与同一机身和模型下的人造技能进行比较.
技能 \\ fty 与 GPT-5.6 卢纳 和 56.9% 的 OpenCode 分别达到 66.5% , 而 与 61.2% 的 和 53.3% 的 人 的 能力 。
Skill \\fty以标准技能包为基础,保持其优势,超越了跨系和骨干模型的人造技能。

blocks.en: 4.5 Where Skill ∞ \infty Helps
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 技能 \\ fit 帮助

blocks.en:
An overall pass rate does not show which tasks benefit from Skill ∞ \infty .
Following SkillEvolver ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , we group tasks by skill utility as defined in Appendix A .
Category A holds tasks that the agent solves without a skill.
B1, B2, and B3 hold partly solved tasks on which human-curated skills improve, preserve, or degrade the pass rate, respectively.
C1 and C2 hold tasks that only human-curated skills solve, at pass rates of at least 40% and below 40%, respectively.

The improvements of Skill ∞ \infty concentrate on tasks beyond the agent’s reach.
On tasks that neither the agent nor human-curated skills solve (D), Skill ∞ \infty reaches 30.5%, against 22.1% for SkillEvolver.
On tasks that only human-curated skills solve at a pass rate of at least 40% (C1), Skill ∞ \infty reaches 29.2%, against 15.4% for SkillEvolver.
Skill ∞ \infty provides the procedural knowledge that the agent lacks, even on tasks that human-curated skills fail to solve.

blocks.en: 4.6 Budget Scaling and Amortized Cost
blocks.zh: 4.6 扩大预算和摊销费用

blocks.en: Figure 5: Pass rate under different search budgets. Test pass rate (avg@5, %) on a subset of SkillsBench tasks. The solid line shows the optimized task skills, and the dashed line the agent without a skill.
blocks.zh: 图5:不同搜索预算的通过率。 测试技能奔驰任务子集的通过率(avg@5,%). 固态线显示优化的任务技能,虚线显示代理机没有技能.

blocks.en:
We ask whether a larger budget yields further gains, given that the meta agent allocates the budget itself.
We run this analysis on a subset of tasks, where the default budget substantially improves the seed task skill.
We then optimize their task skills with budgets of one, two, and eight candidates under otherwise identical settings.
As shown in Figure 5 , the pass rate rises with each doubling of the budget, from 47.5% with one candidate to 82.5% with eight.
Even with a single candidate, the optimized task skills far exceed the agent without a skill (12.5%).
The meta agent allocates each budget itself, so these gains require no retuning of the procedure.
Agent-led optimization scales with the search budget.
blocks.zh:
我们问,如果预算本身由元代理人分配,更大的预算是否会产生进一步的收益。
我们在一组任务上进行这种分析,其中默认的预算大大改善了种子任务的技能。
然后,我们优化了他们的任务技能,预算为一、二和八名候选人。
如图5所示,通过率随着预算的翻一番而上升,从一名候选人的47.5%增加到8名候选人的82.5%。
即使只有一名候选人,优化的任务技能也远远超过没有技能的代理(12.5%).
元代理自行分配每个预算,因此这些收益不需要重新调整程序.
代理主导的优化尺度与搜索预算.

blocks.en:
We measure cost by the tokens that all agents consume during optimization, as itemized in Appendix E .
Optimizing a task skill with the refined meta-skill requires 8.7M input and 66k output tokens on average, close to 8.1M and 76k for SkillEvolver.
The cost of self-improvement is amortized across all task skills optimized afterwards.
Self-improvement consumes about as many tokens as eleven task skill optimizations.
Spread over the 83 task skills, this cost adds less than 15% to each optimization, a share that shrinks with each further reuse of the meta-skill.
By reusing its refined meta-skill, Skill ∞ \infty surpasses SkillEvolver at a comparable cost.
blocks.zh:
如附录E所列,我们按优化过程中所有制剂消耗的符号计量成本。
用精制元技能优化任务技能需要8.7M输入和平均66k输出符,SkillEvolver接近8.1M和76k.
自我改进的费用由后来优化的所有任务技能摊还。
自我改进消耗的符号大约与十一项任务技能优化一样多.
分散在83种任务技能上,这种成本为每次优化增加不到15%,这一份额随着元技能的进一步再利用而缩小。
通过重用其精细的元技能,Skill \\\fty以可比成本超过SkillEvolver.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Skill optimizers have so far followed hand-designed procedures.
Even methods that evolve a meta-skill fix the pipeline around it and relearn it for each task.
We presented Skill ∞ \infty , which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving.
A meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills, and the same agent-led procedure optimizes the meta-skill itself.
The meta-skill, decoupled from task skills, is refined on skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across domains.
At both levels, agents load their skills through native skill discovery, as in deployment.
On SkillsBench, Skill ∞ \infty outperforms human-curated skills and SkillEvolver, and it improves kernel speedups on KernelBench.
Encoding the optimizer’s procedure as a skill makes recursive self-improvement direct, interpretable, and harness-agnostic.
We hope that this view invites further work on agents that improve the way they improve.
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,技能优化者遵循了手工设计的程序。
即使是演化一种元技能的方法也会固定周围的管道,并为每一项任务重新学习.
我们介绍了Skill \\ infty, 这使得技能优化 递归自我提高。
元器件跟随元器件优化任务技能,同样由元器件主导的程序也优化了元器件本身.
与任务技能脱钩的元技能在技能优化任务上得到完善,然后重新使用,以优化各领域的任务技能。
在这两个级别上,特务通过本地技能的发现,如部署中,装载他们的技能。
技能问题 座椅,Skill \\fty 优于人类精准的技巧和SkillEvolver,它改进了内核在Kernel Bench上的速度.
将优化者的程序编码为一种技能,使递归自我改进具有直接性、可解释性和可知性。
我们希望,这种观点将要求就改进方式的代理人开展进一步的工作。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Skill ∞ \infty makes skill optimization recursively self-improving while the backbone model stays fixed.
The resulting gains are therefore bounded by the expressiveness of skill packages.
blocks.zh:
Skill QQ\infty使技能优化在骨干模式保持固定的同时进行回溯性的自我改进.
因此,由此产生的成果取决于一揽子技能的表现形式。

blocks.en:
Both levels of optimization rely on automatic verifiers, since the meta score is computed from task rewards.
Skill ∞ \infty therefore applies to domains in which such rewards can be computed reliably.
blocks.zh:
由于元分数是从任务奖励计算出来的,因此这两个层次的优化都依赖于自动验证器.
因此,技能适用于可以可靠地计算这种奖励的领域。

blocks.en:
Finally, agent-led optimization trades enforcement for flexibility.
The meta agent follows its procedure rather than executing it as code.
The effect of the meta-skill thus depends on how reliably the backbone model follows long instructions.
No tool enforces this adherence, which rests instead on the meta-skill and on independent review.
blocks.zh:
最后,代理人主导的优化贸易执法具有灵活性。
元代理人遵循其程序而不是作为代码执行.
因此,元技能的效果取决于骨干模型如何可靠地遵循长指令.
没有任何工具强制执行这种遵守,而是依靠元技能和独立审查。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Optimized skills bundle instructions and executable scripts that agents follow with tool access, and an agent may activate them without user approval.
We therefore recommend reviewing what these skills do and when they are activated before deploying them.
Some SkillsBench tasks concern cybersecurity and are used only in the form the benchmark provides.
SkillsBench is released under the Apache 2.0 license, and KernelBench and the dataset of SkillEvolver under the MIT license.
We use these artifacts for research evaluation, consistent with their intended use.
blocks.zh:
最佳技能捆绑指令和可执行脚本,代理通过工具访问来遵循,而代理可能不经用户批准而激活.
因此,我们建议在部署这些技能之前审查这些技能的用途和何时启用。
一些技能 座椅任务涉及网络安全,仅以基准提供的形式使用。
技能奔驰根据Apache 2.0许可发布,Kernel Bench和SkillEvolver的数据集根据MIT许可发布.
我们使用这些文物进行研究评估,符合其预期用途.

blocks.en: Appendix C Case Studies
blocks.zh: 附录C 案例研究

blocks.en:
During self-improvement, the meta agent diagnosed the seed meta-skill from the inner optimizations it had guided.
For the 3D scene task, the inner optimization had accepted two consecutive candidates while the verifier still reported the same link-geometry failure.
It had also selected the second candidate, which only tied the parent.
The meta agent located this weakness in the inspection and selection of evaluated candidates rather than in diagnosis.
The candidate meta-skill it wrote requires checking the rollout of each tied or worse candidate for the targeted failure.
A tied candidate can then be selected only when that rollout shows progress.
The candidate improved the meta score from 0.55 to 0.83.
blocks.zh:
在自我改进期间,元剂从它所引导的内在优化中诊断出种子元技能.
对于3D场景任务,内置优化已经接受了连续两位候选人,而核查员仍然报告了相同的链接-几何故障.
它还挑选了第二个候选人,这只与父母有联系。
元代理人在检查和选择被评价的候选人时,而不是在诊断时,都发现了这一弱点。
它写到的候选人元技能要求检查每个被捆绑或更糟糕的候选人在目标失败时的推出情况.
然后,只有在推出时显示出进展时,才能选择有附带条件的候选人。
候选人将元分数从0.55提高到0.83。

blocks.en:
In the next iteration, the meta agent followed this candidate and proposed a further change that tracks intermediate scores and verifier failures across candidates.
The new candidate tied its parent.
Applying the rule it had just written, the meta agent selected the tied candidate only after checking its inner optimization on the 3D scene task.
There, the targeted failure had been addressed, and the task skill had reached a perfect score.
Self-improvement then stopped after two further candidates and retained this candidate as the refined meta-skill.
Across the 83 task skill optimizations, the refined meta-skill selected 54% of tied candidates, against 83% for the seed meta-skill.
Self-improvement changes the behavior of the meta agent, not merely the text of its instructions.
blocks.zh:
在接下来的迭代中,元代理跟踪了这位候选人,并提出了进一步的变化,以跟踪中间分数和对候选人的验证失败.
新候选人将父母捆绑在一起。
应用它刚刚写的规则,元代理只在检查它在3D场景任务上的内在优化后才选择了绑定候选人.
在那里,目标明确的失败得到了解决,任务技能达到了完美的分数。
自我改进之后又在另外两名候选人之后停止了,并保留了这位候选人作为精细的元技能.
在83项任务技能优化中,精细的元技能选取了54%的有线选手,而种子元技能选取率为83%。
自修会改变元代理人的行为,而不仅仅是其指示的文字.

blocks.en:
For a SkillsBench task that exports the parts of a Three.js scene as OBJ files, the seed task skill fails all test trials.
In the first iteration, a rollout of the seed showed that each individual mesh passed while a merged link file failed the verifier’s geometry check.
The meta agent attributed this failure to group ownership and coordinate transforms.
It added an exporter script, wrote the ownership and transform rules into SKILL.md , and rewrote the description to specify the files the skill produces.
Its proposal states a falsifying outcome in terms of the verifier’s check.
The reviewer confirmed that the script exists and matches the documented interface before accepting the candidate.
The optimized skill passes all five test trials.
The boxes below show the optimized task skill and its proposal.
blocks.zh:
对于将一个 3.js 场景部分导出为 OBJ 文件的 Swatch Bench 任务,种子任务技能失败了所有的测试试验 。
在第一次迭代中,一个种子的推出显示,每个个体的网格通过,而一个合并的链接文件却失败了核查者的几何检查.
元代理将这一失败归因于集团所有权和坐标转换.
它增加了一个导出脚本,写出所有权并将规则转换为SKILL.md,并改写描述来指定技能生成的文件.
其提案在核查人核查方面提出了伪造结果。
审查者确认脚本存在,并在接受候选人之前与文件界面匹配.
最佳技能通过所有五个测试。
以下方框显示优化的任务技能及其提案。

blocks.en: ⬇ — name : threejs - structure - parser description : Export named Three . js group parts and transformed OBJ mesh and link files . Load before inspecting files or running commands . — # Task Execution Read the task instruction and inspect every provided input before changing files . Treat the scene hierarchy and verifier as the source of truth for what counts as a part , how nested meshes are assigned , and which coordinate space exports must use . For a scene module that exports ‘ createScene ()‘, use the bundled exporter : “‘ bash node / root /. agents / skills / threejs - structure - parser / scripts / export_scene . mjs / root / data / object . js / root / output “‘ Replace the paths with the task ’ s actual input module and output directory . The script requires ‘ three ‘ to be resolvable from the input module ’ s location . For other module formats or output formats , follow the same rules below in an appropriate exporter . ## Export rules - A mesh belongs to its nearest named ancestor group . Do not assign nested - group meshes to every ancestor . Export each nonempty group as a part directory and a combined link file . - Apply each mesh ’ s full world matrix before writing either an individual mesh OBJ or a merged link OBJ . Group - local vertices omit parent transforms and will misplace parts in world space . - Write one individually named OBJ for every mesh in its assigned part directory . Merge the transformed geometries assigned to that group for its link OBJ ; preserve all component vertices . - Keep names and directory structure required by the instruction . Detect duplicate group or mesh output names instead of silently overwriting files . Before finishing , inspect the exporter output and validate it against the task ’ s supplied tests or verifier . blocks.en:
The seed meta-skill is the starting point of self-improvement, and Skill ∞ \infty w/o self-improvement uses it to optimize all task skills.
Its package contains SKILL.md , three reference files, and a Python script. SKILL.md defines the iteration of Algorithm 1 , the diagnostic procedure for both kinds of targets, and the scores.
The reference files define the workspace and the decision record, the interface of the rollout and evaluation tools, and the review criteria.
The script assembles the archive from the files in the workspace and initializes each candidate as a copy of its parent. SKILL.md and the reference files on the workspace and the tools are reproduced verbatim below.
The front matter retains the package’s internal name.
The names Meta Agent , Task Agent , and Reviewer Subagent in the files correspond to the meta agent, task agent, and reviewer in the paper, respectively.

blocks.en: ⬇ — name : skill - self - evolver description : Optimize a Task Skill or this Meta Skill from rollout reports and evaluation results through candidate generation , scoring , review , and selection . — # Optimize skills Act as the Meta Agent in the supplied workspace . Read this skill ’ s instruction references before applying them . The [ workspace guide ]( references / workspace . md ) defines candidates , the archive , the candidate budget , and decisions . The [ evoctl interface ]( references / evoctl . md ) defines evaluation commands and their results . ## Complete one iteration 1. ** Inspect the archive .** Inspect the archive for the optimization target , parent , active iteration , prior outcomes , and remaining candidate budget . 2. ** Diagnose the parent .** Obtain its rollout with ‘ evoctl rollout ‘, and also the rollouts of its children from earlier iterations that scored no higher than it . Complete the [ diagnostic procedure ](# analyze - the - rollout ), then form falsifiable improvement hypotheses . 3. ** Create candidates .** Create one or two candidates in the active iteration within the remaining candidate budget , each containing a complete copy of the parent ’ s ‘ skill /‘ directory . Use the rollout diagnosis to improve the skill ’ s instructions and resources . Keep the skill ’ s name unchanged and its resource links valid . Write ‘ proposal . json ‘ in each candidate directory with the supporting observation , change , predicted effect , and falsifying outcome . A Meta Skill candidate preserves the [ required responsibilities ]( references / reviewer - policy . md # meta - skill - responsibilities ). 4. ** Evaluate candidates .** Evaluate ready candidates in parallel with ‘ evoctl evaluate ‘. Obtain and read each completed result . 5. ** Review evaluated candidates .** For each scored candidate , start a fresh Reviewer Subagent without inheriting your conversation . Provide absolute paths to the parent directory , the candidate directory , the candidate ’ s ‘ evaluation . json ‘, the parent ’ s ‘ rollout . md ‘, and the currently installed [ reviewer policy ]( references / reviewer - policy . md ). Run ready reviews alongside independent work . Wait for each reviewer to finish and read the candidate ’ s ‘ review . json ‘; use the same reviewer for corrections to that review . 6. ** Select and return .** After every submitted evaluation and the review of every scored candidate finish , refresh the archive . Compare the validation scores of the parent and reviewed candidates , considering reviews , history , and remaining candidate budget , then select whichever ‘ seed ‘ or ‘ accepted ‘ node you judge best . Select a candidate that only ties its parent when its change addresses a failure or requirement identified in the diagnosis . Write the active iteration ’ s [ decision . json ]( references / workspace . md # record - the - decision ), then return . ## Analyze the rollout Analyze the parent ’ s rollout to decide how to improve its skill . Treat the supplied reports , complete task packages including tests and reference solutions , and exported artifacts as read - only materials . Start with the rollout overview and follow relevant trajectory links . Use search and contextual reading to verify the actions and tool results behind an outcome , including subsequent recovery . Expand your reading when evidence is incomplete or conflicting . ### Task Skill 1. ** Understand the tasks and rewards .** Identify the skill ’ s supplied training tasks in the report . Read their instructions and tests / verifier source , including helpers that define the reward conditions . Inspect inputs and reference solutions as needed to understand the required behavior . 2. ** Analyze the execution .** Choose trials covering the relevant success and failure outcomes . Match the Task Agent ’ s actions , tool results , recovery attempts , and final outputs to the task requirements and verifier checks , and note avoidable detours . 3. ** Identify skill improvements .** Compare the Task Skill ’ s guidance with the Task Agent ’ s actual behavior . Identify missing , unclear , misleading , or unnecessary guidance , separating skill issues from execution , environment , and verifier issues . When the Task Agent rewrites or gets wrong a procedure that code can perform , provide that procedure as a script ; when it needs detailed conventions or data , provide them in a reference file linked from ‘ SKILL . md ‘. Propose reusable changes supported by the recorded evidence , preserving guidance that worked . ### Meta Skill 1. ** Locate optimization strengths and weaknesses .** Compare every supplied Task Skill ’ s initial and final validation scores , gains , and the Meta Skill ’ s training score . Select optimization trajectories that explain improvements , regressions , or missed opportunities . 2. ** Analyze the optimization process .** Trace how the Meta Agent and Reviewer Subagent used evidence , modified skills , and responded to feedback through their messages , actions , and tool results . Consult the Task Skill versions , available Task Skill rollouts , and node and iteration records linked from ‘ rollout . md ‘ as needed to verify their diagnoses and changes . 3. ** Identify Meta Skill improvements .** Relate the current Meta Skill ’ s instructions to the observed diagnosis , candidate generation , review , and selection . Determine which guidance would help the Meta Agent produce better Task Skills across the supplied tasks . ## Interpret scores The score , ‘ S ( skill ; evaluation_set )‘, aggregates performance on a fixed training or validation set . A gain is the difference between two scores under the same evaluation conditions . For a ** Task Skill **, the evaluation set contains tasks . The verifier produces a reward for each trial : “‘ text task_score ( s , t ) = mean of trial rewards for task t S ( s ; T ) = mean of task_score ( s , t ) over the supplied tasks t in T “‘ A ‘ timeout ‘ trial is scored on the artifacts present when the Task Agent reached its deadline ; trials without a verifier reward , including ‘ verifier_error ‘, count as zero when averaging trial rewards . For a ** Meta Skill **, the evaluation set contains skill optimization tasks . Each optimization task provides an initial Task Skill with its training and validation sets , and fixed optimization conditions . The Meta Agent uses the Meta Skill and its reviewer policy to optimize that Task Skill . Measure the improvement in its validation score : “‘ text gain ( m , q ) = S ( final Task Skill produced by m ; V_q ) - S ( initial Task Skill ; V_q ) S ( m ; Q ) = mean of gain ( m , q ) over the supplied skill optimization tasks q in Q “‘ Here ‘ V_q ‘ is the validation set for the Task Skill in optimization task ‘ q ‘.

blocks.en: ⬇ # Optimization workspace ‘ WORKSPACE ‘ is the path supplied in the optimization request . ‘ context . json ‘ supplies ‘ optimization_target ‘ (‘ task_skill ‘ or ‘ meta_skill ‘) and this run ’ s candidate budget (‘ budget . max_candidates_per_run ‘). Each node holds one complete skill version . ‘ META_SKILL_DIR ‘ is the directory containing the installed ‘ SKILL . md ‘ you are running . Use that location for this skill ’ s scripts and references . “‘ text WORKSPACE / ├── context . json ├── tasks /< task - skill - id >/< task - id >/ # Training task packages ├── seed / │ ├── node . json │ ├── skill /< skill - name >/ │ ├── evaluation . json │ ├── rollout . md # Created by a rollout request │ └── rollout / └── iterations /000/ ├── candidates / i000 - c1 / │ ├── node . json │ ├── skill /< skill - name >/ │ ├── proposal . json │ ├── evaluation . json │ ├── review . json │ ├── rollout . md # Created by a rollout request │ └── rollout / └── decision . json “‘ The archive is derived from these files . Use the currently installed [ archive helper ](../ scripts / archive . py ), or read and organize the files directly . ## Task Skill rollout ‘ rollout . md ‘ summarizes training results and links to each task trial ’ s trajectory and supporting materials : “‘ text < node >/ rollout /< task - id >/< trial - index >/ ├── trajectory . md # Task Agent and subagent executions ├── verifier / # Recorded verifier results and diagnostics ├── artifacts / # Collected task outputs └── media / # Recorded images “‘ ## Meta Skill rollout ‘ rollout . md ‘ summarizes training results and links to the optimization trajectory and supporting materials for each Task Skill being optimized : “‘ text < node >/ rollout /< task - skill - id >/ ├── trajectory . md # Meta Agent and Reviewer Subagent executions ├── nodes /< node - id >/ # Task Skill , node records , and available rollout reports ├── iterations / # Per - iteration decisions and other recorded files └── media / # Recorded images “‘ ## Inspect the archive “‘ bash python META_SKILL_DIR / scripts / archive . py view – workspace WORKSPACE “‘ The archive view includes ‘ context ‘ from ‘ context . json ‘, nodes , scores , review status , generated - candidate counts , previous decisions , the active parent , ‘ candidate_root ‘, ‘ decision_path ‘, and ‘ remaining_candidates ‘. Creating a candidate consumes one candidate unit , including an unevaluated draft ; keep it in the archive . ## Create a candidate Choose a new directory under the active ‘ candidate_root ‘. Name it ‘ iNNN - cK ‘, where ‘ NNN ‘ is the iteration number and ‘ K ‘ is a positive candidate number . Use the active parent as the source for this iteration . “‘ bash python META_SKILL_DIR / scripts / archive . py create – workspace WORKSPACE – parent - dir PARENT_DIR – candidate - dir CANDIDATE_DIR “‘ The helper copies ‘ PARENT_DIR / skill /‘ to ‘ CANDIDATE_DIR / skill /‘, writes ‘ CANDIDATE_DIR / node . json ‘, and returns the candidate ’ s paths . Edit the copied skill and write ‘ CANDIDATE_DIR / proposal . json ‘. Node metadata has this form , with ‘ name ‘ identifying the directory under ‘ skill /‘: “‘ json { " node_id ": " i000 - c1 ", " parent_id ": " seed ", " iteration_id ": " i000 ", " name ": " skill - name " } “‘ A scored and reviewed candidate is ‘ accepted ‘ or ‘ rejected ‘ according to its review ; unresolved candidates are ‘ proposed ‘. The archive exposes each scored node ’ s ‘ validation_score ‘ from its ‘ evaluation . json ‘. ## Record the decision Write one ‘ decision . json ‘ in the active iteration : “‘ json { " action ": " continue ", " selected_node_id ": " i000 - c1 ", " reason ": " Evidence - grounded selection rationale and next optimization direction ." } “‘ Write exactly these three keys . Use ‘ continue ‘ when the run continues : ‘ selected_node_id ‘ becomes the next iteration ’ s parent . Use ‘ stop ‘ when the run ends , because the candidate budget is exhausted or you choose to finish : ‘ selected_node_id ‘ is the run ’ s final skill . If the candidate budget is later raised , a new iteration continues from that node . blocks.en: ⬇ # evoctl evaluation tools Successful commands return JSON . A correctable input error returns JSON with an ‘ error ‘ message string and a nonzero exit status . Keep a node ’ s skill unchanged once submitted to either command ; further edits belong in a new candidate . ## Obtain a rollout “‘ bash evoctl rollout – workspace WORKSPACE – node - dir NODE_DIR “‘ ‘ NODE_DIR ‘ identifies the skill node to run on the supplied training set . The response contains ‘ optimization_target ‘ ( as defined in the [ workspace guide ]( workspace . md )), ‘ node_id ‘, and ‘ rollout_path ‘. ‘ rollout_path ‘ points to ‘ NODE_DIR / rollout . md ‘, which provides the training score , skill activation , usage , elapsed time , and links to trajectories and supporting materials . Skill activation is reported as ‘ Yes ‘, ‘ No ‘, or ‘ Unknown ‘. ## Evaluate a candidate “‘ bash evoctl evaluate – workspace WORKSPACE – candidate - dir CANDIDATE_DIR “‘ ‘ CANDIDATE_DIR ‘ identifies a [ candidate node ]( workspace . md # create - a - candidate ). The command evaluates the candidate on the supplied validation set and returns JSON containing ‘ node_id ‘, ‘ validation_score ‘, and ‘ skill_activated ‘. The result is saved to ‘ CANDIDATE_DIR / evaluation . json ‘. ‘ skill_activated ‘ is ‘ true ‘ when activation is confirmed across the evaluated executions , ‘ false ‘ when any execution lacks activation , and ‘ null ‘ when unknown .
